title: Chariot-1: India's new model uses 2.5x fewer tokens
takeaways: Up to 2.5x fewer tokens than GPT's tokeniser on Indian text.
LLM ships in 10.7 billion, 1.7 billion and 745 million sizes.
Speech in English plus 10 Indian languages, 97%+ verbalisation accuracy.
Built on a ₹10,372 crore mission with 38,000+ subsidised GPUs.
Foundation-model teams got 83% of the compute subsidy so far.
source_note: Sources: PIB 26 Nov 2026; ThePrint; Kashmir Life; TelecomTalk
